rationale: Wave 1 heavily covered officer/board re-papering (Barnes, Amperse, Sigal, Sen Lonell exit) across UK/IE/Benelux/FR/DACH/IT/ES/PT/Nordics/CEE, statutory headline accounts (BE, DE, FR, CZ, PL, AT, HU, IT, ES, IE, UK), the FL Europe Holdings SL cross-border merger, and SIRENE-based French store closures. Further officer-change hunting has diminishing returns. Wave 2 therefore switches to (1) new official-register modalities that date store-level closures independently of the lagging FL locator (UK council business-rates ratepayer open data, VOA, Irish valuation list); (2) the legal-perimeter questions that would be the earliest hard exit signals and were only flagged as leads (liquidation/merger of entities dropped from DKS Exhibit 21; Dutch 403/404 guarantee withdrawals; any further EU cross-border merger, division or conversion notices in national gazettes; Luxembourg RESA notices); (3) a register no cluster has touched (EUIPO/WIPO/national trademark assignments and licence recordals, the legal footprint a licensing exit would leave); (4) chasing specific CEE/Portugal leads to free primary documents; and (5) free French INPI actes and a SIRENE refresh for the Sep-Oct 2026 window. tasks.title: UK business-rates ratepayer data and Irish valuation list: date FL store exits from official occupier records
tasks.instructions: GOAL: Build a store-by-store list of UK and Irish premises where a Foot Locker entity stopped being the rated occupier in 2025-2026, with dates, using OFFICIAL property-tax records rather than the FL store locator (which lags real closures by weeks to 8+ months). This tests thesis (2): European closures running above consensus (Bloomberg holds FL Europe ~550 stores flat through FY32; DKS reported 559 Europe owned stores at 8/1/26; known run-rate ~22 closures in ~9 months). ENTITIES: Foot Locker U.K. Limited (Companies House 02568406), Freedom Sportsline Limited (01779106, legacy UK FL operating entity), Foot Locker Retail Ireland Limited (CRO 391370), FL Finance (Europe) Ltd (CRO 391464). SOURCES AND METHOD: (A) UK local-council non-domestic rates (NNDR) open data. Many councils publish monthly or quarterly CSV/XLSX lists of business ratepayers (companies only) with property address, rateable value, liability start date and sometimes end date, plus separate lists of empty/void properties. Search each council's open-data or transparency page and data.gov.uk for 'business rates', 'NNDR', 'non-domestic rates ratepayers'. Prioritise councils covering known or suspected FL sites: Lambeth (442 Brixton Road, closed ~Aug-2026), Medway (Pentagon Centre Chatham, closed ~20-Jul-2026), BCP Council (Bournemouth Castlepoint), Birmingham (Bullring, Perry Barr One Stop), Westminster (Oxford Street), Hammersmith & Fulham (Westfield London), Newham (Westfield Stratford), Dartford (Bluewater), Thurrock (Lakeside), Leeds, Manchester, Liverpool (Liverpool ONE relocation to ex-Topshop Church St), Glasgow (Argyle St), Edinburgh, Cardiff, Telford & Wrekin (new store), Sheffield (Meadowhall), Newcastle (Eldon Square), Nottingham, Bristol, Leicester, Croydon, Kingston, Milton Keynes, Reading, Southampton, Belfast (LPS NI). Download the latest file and as many prior snapshots as are published (2024 onward); filter ratepayer names containing 'FOOT LOCKER', 'FOOTLOCKER', 'FREEDOM SPORTSLINE'; diff snapshots to find accounts that disappeared and the dates. (B) VOA 'Find a business rates valuation' (gov.uk, free, no login): look up each known FL address and record the valuation history, effective dates, any 'deleted' or 'merged/split' entries and the current description (a split or re-description after FL left often signals re-letting). (C) Ireland: Tailte Eireann (formerly Valuation Office) public valuation list search, free, searchable by occupier name in many local-authority areas: search occupier 'FOOT LOCKER' nationally; record each property, local authority, occupier and list date. Compare against the 5 stores still on the Irish locator (O'Connell St, Henry St/Ilac, Blanchardstown, Swords, Limerick) and the known exits (44 Upper Grafton St and The Square Tallaght, both gone by Nov-2025). ALREADY KNOWN (do NOT report as novel): UK accounts say 2 openings and 3 closures in 2025 and 3 closures approved for 2026; UK selling space -8.6% in FY2024; named UK closures Brixton 442, Chatham Pentagon, Bournemouth Castlepoint, Birmingham Perry Barr and Bullring Kids from the locator; Liverpool ONE relocation; Telford opening; UK locator 59 (Jul-22) to 49 (Oct-26). NOVEL means: new named closures not in that list, exact liability end dates, empty-property relief claims by FL (a sign of a still-leased but closed store), or a count of FL-rated UK/IE premises that differs from the locator. Also record AGAINST evidence (new FL rating entries in 2026). RULES: Use official council/VOA/Tailte pages and direct file downloads via python requests or WebFetch; WebSearch and the Apify Google scraper budgets were exhausted in wave 1, so prefer direct URLs and data.gov.uk catalogue search. Do not log in, create accounts, pay, or bypass CAPTCHAs; do not submit forms containing personal data (an address search box is fine). Tier A = official council/VOA/Tailte record; computed diffs are Tier A if the inputs are official. Give the exact file URL and snapshot date for each item.

tasks.title: Fate of FL European entities dropped from DKS Exhibit 21, plus Dutch 403/404 guarantee withdrawals
tasks.instructions: GOAL: Find hard registry evidence of the European legal perimeter being simplified or prepared for sale: liquidations, mergers, deregistrations or guarantee withdrawals in 2025-2026 for Foot Locker European entities. Thesis (1): DKS will sell, license or exit Foot Locker Europe. CONTEXT (already known, not novel): DKS's FY2025 10-K Exhibit 21 lists ~20-21 European FL entities and omits ~12-13 that were on FL Inc.'s Feb-2025 list; FL's Spanish holdco Foot Locker Europe Holdings SLU was merged cross-border into Foot Locker Dutch Holdings B.V. (KvK 84791446; draft terms 2026-03-20; Spanish dissolution registered 2026-08-28); Company.info flags a management change at Foot Locker Europe B.V. (KvK 23067735, Utrecht) on 2026-10-02; Foot Locker Denmark ApS deleted; Norway branch still active; officer swaps to Barnes/Amperse/Sigal everywhere. TARGET ENTITIES (dropped from Exhibit 21): FLE Holdings Cooperatief U.A., FL Ventures B.V., Foot Locker Norway B.V., Foot Locker Denmark B.V., Foot Locker Scandinavia B.V. (Netherlands); Runners Point B.V. & Co. KG, Sidestep GmbH (HRB 7347 Recklinghausen), RPG.com GmbH, Foot Locker Germany Holdings GmbH, Runners Point Administration GmbH (HRB 7346) (Germany). ALSO CHECK: Foot Locker Dutch Holdings B.V., Foot Locker Europe B.V., Foot Locker Netherlands B.V. (23063181), FLE Logistics B.V. (14123551, new filing 2026-04-28), Foot Locker Europe.com B.V., Foot Locker Germany GmbH & Co. KG (HRA 4942 Recklinghausen), Foot Locker Germany Administration GmbH. METHOD: (A) Netherlands: the KvK public search (kvk.nl/zoeken) is a JavaScript app; if a real browser tool is available, use it to render free search results, which show status (actief / uitgeschreven / in liquidatie / opgeheven), the number of vestigingen (branches; for Foot Locker Netherlands B.V. this approximates the Dutch store count, compare with 22 on the NL locator) and registration dates. Free mirrors that may expose KvK mutations: oozo.nl, drimble.nl, bedrijvenkompas.nl, openkvk.nl, kvk-check sites, northdata.com/.de (free officer and publication timelines worked in wave 1). Look specifically for 'fusie', 'juridische fusie', 'grensoverschrijdende fusie', 'splitsing', 'ontbinding', 'vereffening', 'turboliquidatie', 'opgeheven', and for 403-verklaring deposits or withdrawals (Dutch subsidiaries often use art. 2:403 BW parent guarantees to skip filing full accounts; withdrawing a 403 declaration and ending residual liability under art. 2:404 BW, which requires a notice and a two-month creditor objection period, is a classic pre-sale step). Search Dutch newspaper 'officiele mededelingen' and KvK-related notices for 'Foot Locker' + '403' / '404' / 'intrekking aansprakelijkheidsverklaring'. Also query the Dutch Centraal Insolventieregister for any FL entity (expect none; a null is useful). (B) Germany: northdata free timelines and handelsregister.de 'Registerbekanntmachungen' / 'Bekanntmachungen' (no login) for each German entity: Verschmelzung, Anwachsung (typical for a GmbH & Co. KG when the partner exits), Formwechsel, Auflosung, Liquidation, Loschung, Sitzverlegung, since 2025-01-01. Note wave 1 found Sidestep/Runners Point Administration managing-director changes (Sigal, 24-Aug-2026) - those are known; you need structural events. (C) For each target entity record: current status, last event, date, register number and source URL; flag any entity that was merged or liquidated after the 2025-09-08 deal close. A null result (all still active, no structural event) is a valid and useful finding and should be logged as AGAINST evidence for imminent restructuring. RULES: No purchases (KvK/Bundesanzeiger documents cost money - list them as leads with exact document names), no login or account creation, no CAPTCHA bypass. WebSearch and Apify Google budgets were exhausted in wave 1; use direct URLs, official APIs and northdata. Tier A = register entry or official notice; Tier B = reputable mirror citing the register.

tasks.title: EU gazette sweep for further FL cross-border mergers, divisions, conversions and capital moves in 2026 (incl. Luxembourg RESA notices)
tasks.instructions: GOAL: Determine whether the Foot Locker Europe Holdings SLU -> Foot Locker Dutch Holdings B.V. cross-border merger (draft terms 2026-03-20, Spanish dissolution registered 2026-08-28; KNOWN, not novel) was a one-off or the first step of a wider reorganisation that collapses FL's European operating companies under one Dutch holdco (making a single share-deal sale or JV of 'FL Europe' executable). Thesis (1). Under the EU mobility directive (2019/2121) each participating company must publish draft terms or a notice of a cross-border merger, division or conversion in its national gazette/register at least a month before approval, and registers exchange data via BRIS. METHOD - search each official gazette for 'Foot Locker' (and 'FL ', 'Kids Foot Locker', 'Runners Point', 'Sidestep', 'Freedom Sportsline', 'Dutch Holdings') from 2025-09-01 to today: (1) EU e-Justice portal 'Find a company' (BRIS) at e-justice.europa.eu - free cross-register search; record each FL entity's register and any listed events. (2) France BODACC C and B via the free BODACC open-data API (bodacc-datadila.opendatasoft.com) for 'projet de fusion', 'fusion transfrontaliere', 'apport partiel d'actif', 'transmission universelle de patrimoine', 'dissolution' for Foot Locker France SAS (SIREN 382401867) and FL France Holdings SAS (480023324). Wave 1 found only accounts deposits and officer changes up to Sep-2026, so focus on Sep-Oct 2026 and on any notice naming Foot Locker Dutch Holdings B.V. (3) Germany: handelsregister.de Registerbekanntmachungen for 'grenzuberschreitende Verschmelzung' / 'Verschmelzungsplan' involving Foot Locker Germany GmbH & Co. KG (HRA 4942) and holdings. (4) Italy: Gazzetta Ufficiale Parte Seconda (free search on gazzettaufficiale.it, 'Foglio delle inserzioni') for 'Foot Locker Italy' fusione/scissione/trasformazione/riduzione capitale. (5) Belgium Staatsblad/Moniteur (ejustice.just.fgov.be, free) for Foot Locker Belgium BV: 'grensoverschrijdende fusie', 'inbreng', 'kapitaal', 'ontbinding' in 2026 (wave 1 found only director changes through Jun-2026; refresh to today). (6) Luxembourg RESA / LBR (lbr.lu, free consultation): retrieve and read notices L260079455, L260105987, L260223548, L260244062 and L260371724 for the Foot Locker Belgium Luxembourg branch RCS B39434 (wave 1 could not reach LBR: maintenance/HTTP 429). Say who changed as branch representative and whether any notice concerns closure of the branch or transfer of business. (7) Austria: Amtsblatt / EVI (evi.gv.at, free) for Foot Locker Austria GmbH (FN 165131 s) Verschmelzung or Spaltung. (8) Ireland: CRO Gazette (weekly PDF, free on cro.ie) for Foot Locker Retail Ireland Ltd (391370) and FL Finance (Europe) Ltd (391464): cross-border merger notices, section 1202 merger, strike-off or voluntary liquidation; also the B10 filings received 05/10/2026 for FL Finance (Europe) and 11/03 and 23/07/2026 for FL Retail Ireland - check whether the free CRO 'submission' listing shows any other form types (e.g. CBM, M1, E1, B2 registered-office change). (9) Portugal publicacoes.mj.pt, Poland Monitor Sadowy i Gospodarczy index, Czech Obchodni vestnik / justice.cz, Hungary Cegkozlony for any merger notice involving the local FL subsidiary. (10) Switzerland: re-query the Zefix REST API (https://www.zefix.admin.ch/ZefixREST/api/v1/firm/788393.json, Foot Locker Switzerland LLC, CHE-112.305.091, Basel) and SHAB/FOSC for any publication after 2026-07-27 (Auflosung, Liquidation, Sitzverlegung, Zweck change); FL's Swiss web shop and locator domains are already known to be offline. KNOWN (not novel): all officer swaps to Barnes/Amperse/Sigal/Zipfel; Sen Lonell's removal; Petersson's exit; the Spanish merger itself; no BODACC capital change since 2011. NOVEL: any further merger/division/conversion/capital-reduction/dissolution notice, any notice naming a third-party (non-FL/DKS) counterparty, any branch closure, or a confirmed null across all registries (log a clean null as AGAINST evidence). RULES: official gazettes and free open-data APIs only; no paid extracts, logins, account creation or CAPTCHA bypass; WebSearch/Apify Google budgets were exhausted in wave 1, so go direct to the gazette search endpoints. Quote the original-language text and translate it.

tasks.title: Trademark registers: FOOT LOCKER / atmos / legacy-banner mark assignments, licence recordals and DKS filings in Europe
tasks.instructions: GOAL: Use official trademark registers, which no cluster has searched yet, to find the legal footprint of a European sale or licensing exit (thesis 1), or evidence against it. A licensing conversion of FL Europe (the template FL used for SE Europe with Fourlis, the Middle East with Alshaya, India with Metro Brands and SE Asia with MAP) would typically show up as exclusive licence recordals, assignments of national/EU marks to a regional entity or to a licensee, or new filings by a licensee. Conversely, DKS filing its own banners (DICK'S, DSG, House of Sport, Fast Break, Golf Galaxy, Public Lands, GameChanger) in the EU/UK would suggest it is keeping or expanding there. SOURCES (all free, no login): EUIPO eSearch plus (euipo.europa.eu/eSearch) and the EUIPO open data; TMview (tmdn.org/tmview) which aggregates EU national offices (DE DPMA, FR INPI, IT UIBM, ES OEPM, NL/BE/LU BOIP, PL, CZ, HU, AT, PT, IE, Nordics); WIPO Madrid Monitor (international registrations designating the EU or European countries) and WIPO Global Brand Database; UK IPO 'search for a trade mark' (assignments and licences recorded on the UK register). SEARCH TERMS: FOOT LOCKER, KIDS FOOT LOCKER, LADY FOOT LOCKER, FOOTLOCKER, FLX, HOME OF SNEAKERS / 'SNEAKER' slogans FL uses in Europe, ATMOS, ATMOS PINK, RUNNERS POINT, SIDESTEP, CHAMPS SPORTS, WSS, plus owner names Foot Locker Retail, Inc., Foot Locker, Inc., Foot Locker Europe B.V., FL Europe, DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc. and DKS-related applicants. FOR EACH RELEVANT MARK record: number, office, owner (and owner history), filing/registration/renewal dates, status, and every recordal with its date (transfer/assignment, licence, security interest, change of name/address, cancellation, non-renewal or surrender). Pay particular attention to events dated 2025-05-15 (deal announcement) onward: owner changes from Foot Locker Retail, Inc. to a DKS entity (routine post-merger, note it as such), any partial/territorial assignment to a European or third-party entity, licence recordals naming third parties (Fourlis/Trade Estates, Alshaya, Metro Brands, MAP Active, JD Sports, Frasers, Sport Vision, Grupo Axo or any unknown company), lapsed/unrenewed European marks for legacy banners (Runners Point, Sidestep - those banners closed earlier, so lapse is weak evidence), and NEW EU/UK filings by DKS for its own brands or by Foot Locker for new European concepts (e.g. reimagined store formats, Fast Break) after the deal. Optionally, for APAC context only, check IP Australia (search.ipaustralia.gov.au) and J-PlatPat for FOOT LOCKER and ATMOS owner changes since 2025-05. ALREADY KNOWN (not novel): FL licensing partners and pre-deal exits; DKS kept the FL brand; FL EU consumer terms reissued 1-Jul-2026 deleting DK/NO/SE seller entities. RULES: official registers only; no login, payment or CAPTCHA bypass; WebSearch/Apify Google budgets were exhausted in wave 1, so use the registers' own search pages/APIs directly (EUIPO and TMview have JSON endpoints behind their UIs; a real browser tool may be needed). Tier A = register record. Explicitly log a null result per office if nothing post-deal is found.

tasks.title: France: free INPI RNE actes for FL France entities and a Sep-Oct 2026 SIRENE establishment refresh

France is FL Europe's second-largest market (~140-142 stores on the locator; EC M.11159 put FL at 145 French stores in 2024). Theses: (1) exit/sale/licensing; (2) closures above consensus (Bloomberg ~550 Europe stores flat through FY32). KNOWN (not novel): BODACC B 2026-04-21 notices that Matthew Campbell Barnes was appointed by sole-shareholder decision of 13 Apr 2026, and Erik Amperse as Directeur general from 21/04/2026; Sep-2026 'Generaldir.' entries; CY2024 accounts (revenue EUR 394.85M, EBIT EUR 17.06M); SIRENE net closures 4 (2023), 5 (2024), 8 (Jan-Sep 2025), no 2026 openings; named closures Avignon rue des Marchands (15-Sep-2026), Marseille Centre Bourse, Lyon Confluence, Paris Bastille, Chartres, Paris Hotel de Ville 66 rue de Rivoli (locator); no PSE/RCC in DILA ACCO; reported APC mobility agreement (Jul-Aug 2026). METHOD: (1) annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr (free, no login) has a 'Documents' / 'Actes et statuts' section that proxies INPI RNE filings for download, and a 'Comptes annuels' section. For both SIRENs list every acte deposited since 2025-01-01 with its date and type, download those that are freely downloadable, and read in particular: the act filed 11/08/2025 for FL France ('composition' change four weeks before the deal close), the April 2026 decisions, the Sep-2026 filings, and any later filing. Report whether the CY2025 comptes annuels of Foot Locker France SAS (due by ~mid-2026) have been deposited, whether a 'declaration de confidentialite' was elected (a new confidentiality election post-deal would itself be a signal), or whether nothing was deposited (overdue). (2) SIRENE refresh: use the free recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr API (and/or the INSEE SIRENE open data / annuaire-entreprises establishment list) to pull ALL establishments (etablissements) of SIREN 382401867 with etat administratif and date de fermeture; list every establishment closed (etat F) with a closure date from 2025-09-08 to today, especially Jul-Oct 2026, with SIRET, address and closure date; separate relocations (a new SIRET opened at the same mall/city within ~3 months) from true closures. Resolve these specific leads: Besancon La Galerie Chateaufarine (SIRET 38240186701387; de-listed from the locator city page between 2026-08-19 and 2026-10-07); Metz store 5358 (removed from the locator after 2026-05-18; identify whether the SIRET is 00413 or 01726 and its status); Paris 66 rue de Rivoli (SIRET 38240186701833); Les Ulis 2, Mulhouse 24 rue des Marechaux and Fresnes 1 rue de la Loge (removed from locator but Actif in SIRENE in wave 1 - re-check status). Compute the updated net-closure count for calendar 2025 and 2026 YTD. Also note any NEW establishment opened in 2026 (AGAINST evidence). RULES: free official data only; no login, account creation, payment or CAPTCHA bypass; WebSearch/Apify Google budgets were exhausted in wave 1, so call the APIs directly with python requests.
